purpose: Starting point when nothing about the plant is known: the hardware facts and owner limits, plus gains that are safe for any plausible inertia and uncorrected crosstalk. Identification replaces everything under servo_parameters except the limits.

hardware_signature.motor: GM6020, CAN current mode (0x1FE), feedback 0x205 at 1 kHz
hardware_signature.owner_rules: below 100 RPM; high acceleration at low speed is acceptable; yaw current up to 3 A peak and 1.62 A continuous, 0.8 A is thermal guidance only (2026-10-02)

safe_gains_basis: see tools/servo_commission/README; prior stall recovery off and integral authority 1.4 A, because both are friction-dependent and set from the survey
design_rules_basis: crosstalk_drift_fraction 1.0: the design boundary is taken with the crosstalk table wrong by its own largest |g| (the loop survives losing the compensation). Station 2026-10-02: the reading moved 3 mrad/A off the morning's table within the day and the yaw buzzed at standstill; see tools/servo_commission/design.py.
